summary: CTW, a Tokyo-based game platform operator listed on Nasdaq, furnished a Form 6-K reporting fiscal year 2026 results for the period ended July 31, 2026. Revenue fell 9% year over year to $82.5 million, segment profit rose 3% to $32.3 million, and the company posted a net loss of $4.1 million, or $0.07 per share, versus $3.8 million net income a year earlier. Adjusted EBITDA was $3.5 million. Management will host an earnings webinar on October 16, 2026. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms were disclosed.
